scores.doc: CDS 2025-2026 C9 blank: UC does not use SAT or ACT in admission

testPolicy.text: UC Irvine, like every UC campus, does not consider SAT or ACT scores in admission decisions or in awarding Regents and Chancellor's scholarships; scores may be used for the statewide guarantee, minimum eligibility or course placement.
testPolicy.since: test-blind since fall 2023 entry for California applicants, extended to nonresidents (Regents decision of May 21, 2020; UC will not consider SAT or ACT scores in admission decisions or Regents and Chancellor's scholarships)

gpa.doc: CDS 2025-2026 C11/C12 blank; UC's fall 2026 admit snapshot gives a middle-50% high school GPA of 4.06-4.27 for admits

inState.totalIncludes: new undergraduates 2026-27 living on campus: systemwide fees 15,588 + campus fees 4,701 + housing 12,053 + food 7,323 + books and supplies 1,512 + personal 2,801 + transportation 1,228 = 45,206

outOfState.totalIncludes: add 39,270 Nonresident Tuition and Fees to the resident budget; 84,476 is the computed sum

aidPromise.text: Blue and Gold: most California families earning up to $100,000 receive enough grant and scholarship money to cover UC tuition. Tuition predictability: a UC student's tuition is set at first enrollment and stays the same for up to six years. Blue and Gold applies to California residents only.

deadlines.regular: November 30 (UC application filing period for fall 2027 entry, opens August 1)

facts.text: For fall 2025, Californians filed 86,230 applications and got 18,922 admissions (21.9%), while out-of-state U.S. applicants got 7,784 of 16,381 (47.5%) and international applicants 9,258 of 21,620 (42.8%).
Of UC Irvine's 6,421 enrolled first-years in fall 2025, 4,870 were Californians, 472 out-of-state U.S. students and 1,079 international students.
UC Irvine admitted 5,737 students from its fall 2025 waiting list, almost every one of the 5,738 who accepted a place.
For fall 2026 UC Irvine admitted 38,165 of 126,005 first-year applicants (preliminary), a 30.3% rate.
Nonresidents add $39,270 of Nonresident Tuition and Fees to UC Irvine's $45,206 on-campus resident budget for 2026-27.
UC guarantees first-year admission to a UC campus, though not necessarily the campus of choice, to California students in the top 9 percent of their high school or of the state.

notes: CDS 2025-26 is a fillable PDF (values from form fields; PDF listed on https://irap.uci.edu/common-data-set/). CDS section G and C12 are blank. Rates in facts are computed from CDS counts. Fall 2026 numbers are preliminary. No early plans; one UC application due November 30.
